ability.h.note: Radio chirp climbing with a bright bell shimmer.

ability.z.note: A rising wail with a hiss: something hungry woke up.

amb_map.h.note: Human map bed (36 s loop): distant wind, faint radio static, the odd far-off thud, clank and radio chirp. Very quiet.

amb_map.z.note: Zombie map bed (40 s loop): sub drone, thermal hum, slow wet breathing and a faint heartbeat. Dark and very quiet.

bitten.note: The bite: a crunch, a wet tear, a low impact, two fast heartbeats and a thin whine.

broadcast.note: Emergency broadcast: static opens, the dual-tone attention signal sounds, static swallows it. ~3.4 s.

burn.note: The other half burns or dissolves away: a roaring sweep with crackle. ~2.4 s.

claim.h.note: Rubber stamp, coin, and a confirming ding: paperwork done.

claim.z.note: A low pulse and a swallowed tone: taken.

commit.note: Commit impact: a huge low boom with a crack and a long dark tail.

contact.h.note: CONTACT: emergency klaxon. Radio key-up, three alert chirps, then a hi-lo two-tone siren (4 cycles) with static. Bright, dense, ~2.6 s.

contact.z.note: CONTACT: predatory. A heartbeat spike that accelerates, a hiss swelling with a rattle, a roar, then a rising screech. ~2.6 s.

crit.h.note: Hit plus a metal ring and a crack: the big one.

crit.z.note: A crunch, a roar and a sub boom: something broke.

dodge.h.note: Air and cloth: you slipped it.

dodge.z.note: A low slither past: it slid away.

dot.h.note: A small sizzle: burning or bleeding, ticking down.

dot.z.note: A single heavy drip: venom, ticking down.

downed.h.note: Signal lost: static swell, a falling carrier, a thud.

downed.z.note: Going under: two heavy beats slowing, a long exhale sinking.

echo.h.note: Echo report: a pager's three short beeps.

echo.z.note: Echo report: two wet pulses and a faint whisper of breath.

engage.h.note: Key-up squelch, a rising two-tone chirp and a low thud: you commit.

engage.z.note: A growl, two fast heartbeats and a hiss: it has locked on.

equip.h.note: Metal latch snapping home with a leather strap rustle.

equip.z.note: Something heavy settling onto wet muscle.

error.h.note: Two soft falling radio beeps: not available.

error.z.note: A short, low, dull grunt: no.

fell.h.note: A thud and a radio carrier falling away to nothing: you're down.

fell.z.note: A guttural groan sinking, a heartbeat slowing to a stop.

flatline.note: The long flat tone (looped by code, faded out on stop).

flip.h.note: A card turning over on a table.

heal.h.note: A cap twisting off, then a gentle rising chime: relief.

heal.z.note: A thick swallow and a warm pulse spreading.

healtick.h.note: One soft high 'tink': a point of health returning.

healtick.z.note: A warm low pulse: blood moving.

heart.note: One lub-dub. The code repeats it, faster and harder as the hold builds.

held.h.note: Short brass-and-radio stinger, resolving upward: you held the line.

held.z.note: A low swell and a satisfied exhale over two strong beats: fed.

hit.h.note: A solid thwack: blunt, dry, a little bright.

hit.z.note: A wet smack with a deep thump under it.

levelup.h.note: LEVEL UP: radio squelch, brass fanfare (rising fourth, held major chord), bell sparkle. About 2.6 s.

levelup.z.note: LEVEL UP: guttural swell: sub drone climbing, dark chord opening, a roar, heartbeats. About 2.6 s.

ping.h.note: Hostile signal, subtle: a faint sonar blip with two echoes.

ping.z.note: Hostile signal, subtle: two soft low throbs, like a pulse felt through the floor.

purchase.z.note: The same coins, dropped into something wet and deep.

rar_common.z.note: Rarity 1: one beat and a low bell.

rar_legendary.h.note: LEGENDARY: brass chord swell, bell cascade, sub boom, radio glitter. Longest, fullest.

rar_legendary.z.note: LEGENDARY: triple heartbeat, dark choir pad, guttural roar, hiss glitter, sub boom.

rar_rare.h.note: Rarity 3: a bright four-note arpeggio over a swelling pad.

rar_rare.z.note: Rarity 3: three beats, a growl swell, a falling minor arpeggio of dark bells.

rar_uncommon.h.note: Rarity 2: two rising bells and a glint.

rar_uncommon.z.note: Rarity 2: two beats over a minor third of dark bells.

revived.h.note: Defibrillator charge climbing, a thump, then a clean bright chime: back up.

revived.z.note: A sharp inhale, then the heart restarts strong.

riser.note: Hold-to-commit riser, exactly 3.0 s: rising noise and tone, accelerating pulse. Ends at full intensity.

scrap.h.note: A hard chop and a rattle of loose metal.

scrap.z.note: A wet tearing squelch and crunch.

sheet_close.h.note: The same latch going back down.

sheet_open.h.note: Paper sliding up and a latch: a clipboard being lifted.

sheet_open.z.note: A low swell rising through flesh-coloured light.

tab.h.note: A rocker switch: slightly longer than a tap, clicks over.

tab.z.note: Low double-pulse under a soft click; the heat lens changes channel.

tap.h.note: Marker-tip tap: a dry paper-and-plastic click with a small high tick.

tap.z.note: Soft wet pop with a low body, like pressing on something warm.

theme.note: Main-menu / onboarding theme (96 s loop, A minor, 60 bpm): slow dark pad, sub, a heartbeat that enters in the second third, sparse bells with long echo, wind and radio hiss.

upgrade.h.note: Latch, then two rising bell strikes: a part machined into place.

upgrade.z.note: A dull thud and a low organic swell with a dark bell.

xp.h.note: A tiny bright pluck, played repeatedly as the XP bar fills (pitch climbs in code).

xp.z.note: A tiny low blip for the same job.
